name: NiceJob
summary: Automates asking customers for reviews and showcases them on your site. Reporting and customisation are fairly basic, and the automation only amplifies the service you already deliver.
best_for: local and service businesses that want reputation marketing on offense — automatically asking happy customers for reviews and showcasing them — rather than only managing damage when a bad review lands
skip_if: you need deep reporting or highly customized review workflows, or your service quality isn't ready for more visibility yet — fix that first, then amplify it
honest_knock: Reporting and customization are fairly basic and there's a setup fee on top of the monthly. It automates review collection genuinely well, but if you want deep analytics or granular control over timing and wording, it can feel restrictive. And the honest fundamental: automation only amplifies the service you actually deliver. It keeps the review stream fresh and steady (which matters — stale reviews lose trust fast, and AI search increasingly recommends businesses on review signals), but it cannot manufacture a reputation you haven't earned.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-11 on their own pricing page) Software plans are Reviews at $75/mo and Pro at $125/mo, both USD, with a 14-day free trial, no credit card up front and no contracts. The website plans are Sites at $99/mo and Grow + Sites at $174/mo, each with a one-off $199 setup fee; the software-only plans carry no setup fee. The page also runs a contact-count ladder that the headline figures hide: Grow is $75 for 1-2,500 customers, $95 above 2,500, $145 above 5,000 and $290 above 10,000, and Grow + Sites is $174, $194, $244 and $389 across the same steps — an even $99 apart at every rung. Sites add-ons are billed on top: an extra landing page is $145 one-time plus $15/mo, and a CMS for blogs, services or locations is $245 one-time plus $15/mo.
